anomalies.observed: The netlist includes both U2 (ATtiny45-20P) and U3 (ATtiny13V-10S). Their corresponding power, reset, and GPIO pins are connected to the same nets, including both PB1 pins on PWM and both PB4 pins on TACH.
anomalies.expected: A fan controller should have one MCU driving these shared control and signal nets, unless one MCU is explicitly designated as an unpopulated alternative. The files provide no such indication.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are populated, they share all supplies and control signals. Their GPIO outputs can contend, and programming or reset behaviour may be unreliable. If one is meant to be an alternative, the design files do not identify which device should be omitted.

parsed.summary: The design contains two MCU components whose corresponding pins are tied to the same control nets. Unless one is deliberately left unpopulated as an undocumented alternative, this creates a risk of conflicting MCU outputs and unreliable operation.
